facts.fact: The Villager reports CRAN has used the Universal Service Fund to prioritise regions with less than 80% 4G coverage, including Kavango West, Kavango East, Kunene, Ohangwena and Oshikoto, in line with the National Broadband Policy.
The Kavango East regional education director told parliament's ICT committee the region had received only one tower through the Universal Service Fund.
